answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 21831 Country: India Title: my ques. is many medicines contains alcohol like cough syrup, is it halal or haram? Question: Assalamwalaykum, my ques. is many medicines contains alcohol like cough syrup, is it halal or haram? Answer ID: 21831 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 649/649/M=1431) Use of alcohol prepared from haram ingredients is unlawful, but usually in India alcohol is prepared from lawful ingredients; therefore it is not haram. And the use of medicine which contains such alcohol is also not unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
